# raktim-mondol/co-scientist — source dossier

**Scope:** M5 source assessment. No upstream setup, agent workflow, dependency install, or inference has been run.

## Pinned source and reuse boundary

- Upstream: [raktim-mondol/co-scientist](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist), pinned at [`10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45`](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/commit/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45). The clean, detached working copy is ignored at `references/work/raktim-mondol-co-scientist/` and will be removed before the next source.
- The root [LICENSE](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/LICENSE) declares MIT and copyright 2025 Raktim Mondol. The tracked `x_code/` tree, however, is described by its own [README](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/x_code/README.md#L50-L75) as a fork of Anthropic Claude Code recovered from an exposed source map; its [license section](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/x_code/README.md#L356-L360) says the original belongs to Anthropic. The root MIT declaration does not establish permission to reuse that component. Exclude `x_code/` and CLI/TUI implementations derived from it from execution and reuse. Assess scientific techniques in the root `src/` tree as ideas; independently implement accepted changes to avoid uncertain code provenance. No upstream code has been copied.
- The checkout has 2,181 tracked files, including 1,931 under `x_code/`; there is no tracked submodule. The relevant scientific implementation is under `src/agents/`, `src/memory/`, `src/taskQueue/`, `src/tools/`, `src/prompts/`, and `src/tests/`.

## Architecture and inspected areas

- **Runtime and persistence:** The project is a Bun/TypeScript CLI. [Package scripts and dependencies](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/package.json) use Drizzle/SQLite, sqlite-vec, OpenAI's client, Parallel Web, MCP, PQueue, Zod, Ink, and Handlebars. Its [schema](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/db/schema.ts#L1-L190) persists sessions, hypotheses, reviews, matches, proximity edges, task records, claim citations, embeddings, and feedback. The [queue](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/taskQueue/queue.ts) executes through in-memory PQueue rather than a leased durable queue; task logging does not itself supply restart recovery. The local FastAPI/LangGraph/SQLite task architecture therefore remains the execution contract.
- **Scientific modules:** The root `src/agents/` tree has generation, literature research, reflection, ranking, judge debiasing, evolution, proximity, provenance, citation integrity, experiment design, meta-review, and report modules. `src/prompts/` contains corresponding YAML prompts, including staged reflection and debate comparison. The detailed mechanism map and local comparison below distinguish code paths from advertised features.
- **Operations and scope:** [Configuration](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/config.ts#L1-L55) requires a DeepSeek API key and defaults to a 500,000-token run budget; the [example environment](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/.env.example) also describes Parallel Web and optional Consensus/Scite credentials. Importing configuration may read ambient credentials, so assessment is static until a justified isolated test is defined. The [roadmap](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/docs/ROADMAP.md) explicitly labels diversity-aware generation, mid-run steering, contradiction-driven experiments, real model tiering, LLM-based feedback reward extraction, a judge ensemble, and cost-aware scheduling as unimplemented or unselected. These are not shipped evidence.

## Mechanism map and source-versus-local comparison

Only concrete shipped behavior can motivate a candidate. The [paper corpus](../../docs/CORPUS-EXTRACTION.md) states that Google's ranking agent uses an Elo-based tournament, initialized at 1200, with pairwise debates and new/near-rating pairing. That is a **Google-backed requirement**. The mechanisms below are **external techniques**; similarity of agent names does not establish Google fidelity.

### Ranking, scheduling, and proximity

- **Ratings:** The source implements Glicko-2 with rating deviation and volatility in [tournament.ts](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/models/tournament.ts#L169-L236), with [numeric tests](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/tests/core.test.ts#L88-L176). Local `engine/src/co_scientist/agents/ranking/ranking_elo.py` preserves the paper-backed Elo contract. Glicko-2 is a different rating model; a higher number or self-rating would not show scientific improvement.
- **Position bias:** The source [judges both orders](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/agents/ranking.ts#L165-L212) on its simple-comparison path and tests the adjudication helper in [judgeDebias.test.ts](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/tests/judgeDebias.test.ts#L8-L49). Its deeper debate path runs once in random orientation. Local `ranking_debate.py` already alternates presentation across debate turns and matchups, requires opposite-order consensus after minimum depth, and has regression coverage in `engine/tests/test_ranking_debate_consensus.py`. The source's stronger-sounding debias label is therefore not a blanket guarantee across both paths.
- **Pair selection:** The source [prioritizes rating deviation divided by match count](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/agents/ranking.ts#L309-L346), then considers a proximity neighbor and random choice among other high-priority candidates. Local `ranking_matchmaking.py` already weights recency, rank, coverage, Elo closeness and cluster similarity, with no-starvation and seeded-replay tests in `engine/tests/test_ranking_matchmaking.py`. Explicit rating deviation is novel relative to local Elo, but the source provides no isolated evidence that it improves useful ranking decisions.
- **Rating persistence:** The source [updates two hypothesis ratings in one SQLite transaction](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/memory/stores/hypothesisStore.ts#L113-L146), but [writes the match record later](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/agents/ranking.ts#L105-L142), so the entire match is not atomic. Local `ranking.py` applies updates sequentially in its engine state; durable checkpoint and restart behavior require a separate comparison before adopting a persistence technique.
- **Generation-time diversity:** Contrary to its stale [roadmap entry](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/docs/ROADMAP.md#L20-L34), the source [embeds candidates and rejects near neighbors before save](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/agents/generation.ts#L104-L147), with [behavior tests](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/tests/generation-diversity.test.ts#L87-L126). It also computes [post-hoc proximity edges](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/agents/proximity.ts#L17-L109). Local `proximity.py` deduplicates after generation and evolution has its own duplicate guard; the timing and safe zero-cost embedding path need examination before treating the early filter as an improvement.
- **Budgets and replay:** The source [scheduler](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/taskQueue/queue.ts#L127-L279) stops at a token budget and samples weighted agent tasks, but does not allocate from the remaining budget and uses an in-memory queue. Its [seeded global RNG](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/util/rng.ts#L1-L68) is tested, yet replay still depends on execution order. Local ranking has a run-level match budget, minimum pair coverage, and pairing-local deterministic seeds. Those local durability and budget properties must not be weakened by importing the source scheduler.

### Research, evidence, reflection, feedback, and experiment design

- **Research and failure handling:** [LiteratureResearchAgent](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/agents/literatureResearch.ts#L72-L188) runs bounded search, planning and extraction rounds; failed extractions are skipped, and generation falls back to search snippets if it gathers no readable source. The [search tool](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/tools/search.ts#L170-L267) has provider fallbacks and an empty-search counter that eventually stops generation. [Deep-research tests](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/tests/deepResearch.test.ts#L137-L303) cover missing credentials, empty extraction and round limits, but not the circuit breaker or a real provider outage. Local `literature_review/search_retry.py` and `orchestration.py` retry and isolate branches; `app/app/research_provenance.py` persists retrieval calls and degraded outcomes. The source behavior is a failure-mode comparison, not proof that an additional halt improves local runs.
- **Evidence and provenance:** [EvidenceStore](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/memory/stores/evidenceStore.ts#L10-L97) persists source metadata. The [ProvenanceAgent](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/agents/provenance.ts#L23-L136) extracts a few claims, checks each against one top search-result abstract, and stores support verdicts. No dedicated provenance-agent test was found. Local `app/app/claim_verifier.py` and research provenance records use claim-to-passage evidence and publication gates; a one-abstract verdict cannot replace those checks. The source [citation resolver](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/tools/citationResolver.ts#L316-L363) also recovers DOIs from publisher pages or Crossref search, with mocked resolver/failure tests in `src/tests/citationResolver.test.ts`; whether this fills a local metadata gap is a separate question.
- **Reflection:** The [reflection cascade](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/agents/reflection.ts#L76-L195) runs initial and full reviews, provenance and citation checks, then deep verification, simulation and observation reviews. Only initial/full failure rejects; later judgments affect ratings. Its [simulation prompt](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/prompts/reflection/simulation_review.yaml#L1-L29) is a model thought experiment, not executed simulation. No test of the full reflection sequence was found. Local `engine/src/co_scientist/agents/reflection/` already has staged review, deep verification, observations and evidence gates. An extra call is useful only if it changes an observable scientific decision without material regression.
- **Empirical feedback:** The source [reward signal](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/rlef/reward-signal.ts#L16-L125) maps keyword sentiment plus optional 0–10 reviewer-like scores to a Glicko-2 update; [reward memory](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/rlef/reward-store.ts#L26-L129) recalls strong signals across sessions, and [prompt injection](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/rlef/prompt-injection.ts#L21-L60) feeds them to later agents. [RLEF tests](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/tests/rlef.test.ts#L117-L359) cover formulas, storage, retrieval and manual composition, not real-outcome validity or the excluded CLI submission path. Local reviewer/meta-review feedback is not a record of independently observed experimental outcomes. This is a distinct possible gap; keyword scoring and direct rating changes are not validated evidence handling.
- **Experiment design:** The [ExperimentDesignAgent](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/agents/experimentDesign.ts#L18-L88) saves a detailed protocol for top ideas after supervisor plateau, using a [prompt](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/prompts/experiment_design/protocol.yaml#L31-L51) that requests steps, controls, outcomes, materials, timing and cost tier. No agent-specific behavior test was found. Local `engine/src/co_scientist/agents/generation/experiment_plan.py` already formats steps and Go/No-Go criteria, but has no separate post-run protocol builder. Any added detail would need source grounding, feasibility and safety validation before publication.
- **Reports:** The source [ReportAgent](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/agents/report.ts#L28-L160) combines model prose with deterministic methods, ranking and protocol summaries plus a resolved bibliography. [Report tests](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/tests/report.test.ts#L46-L219) cover bibliography, rendering and persistence, not the full manuscript-generation path. Local `app/app/report_build.py` assembles evidence-grounded reports with safety and claim gates. Manuscript export is a format opportunity, not an observed correctness gain.

## M5 candidate register

All source mechanisms are **external techniques** unless the retained Google corpus independently establishes a requirement. Candidate IDs, test boundaries, costs, and dispositions will be recorded after source-versus-local comparison.

No M5 implementation or inference has run yet. The checkout is a static reference, not a runtime dependency.
